screenshots.caption: This example calls the sound root UA. Select a file to enable Preview.
The retrieved plan is BAW, A20N, from EGLL to EHAM. Check your own flight details.
The shared Announcement panel, connected to the app with MSFS disconnected. Boarding and both seatbelt tiles are shown.
80% main volume, with Cockpit 25%, Cabin 100% and External 0%.
BAW uses Ryan for Pilot and Brian for Flight Attendant on the Edge provider.
General Functionality: Enable 3rd party plugins is ON.
Either pack category is suitable. Fenix ownership is not required.
Flight details in the shared panel. Native window controls and desktop Always on top are not shown in this capture.
All recordings filtered by Cabin in an example ACA collection. Select a result to request that exact file.
Example saved values, not defaults: 7,000/5,000 ft, 6-minute departure delay, 1.11g and NOAA (live). The reference tables give defaults.
